# Values that the sensitive-data guard may find in this repository.
# Every entry is either an intentional fake (test fixture, documentation
# placeholder) or an intentionally public contact address. Real plant
# addresses, real PINs, real myIDM ids, tokens and personal data must
# NEVER be added here - rotate them instead.
# Entries may start or end with "*" for wildcard matching.
